nodes.label: SEC-01: try! → try? Safe ModelContainer Init
nodes.rationale: IntentContainer.shared used try! causing a hard crash when the Shortcuts extension encountered a corrupted or migrating SwiftData store. Changed to try? + guard so the error surfaces as a user-visible message instead of a silent crash.
nodes.norm_label: sec-01: try! → try? safe modelcontainer init

nodes.label: FormatterCache Performance Fix
nodes.rationale: Every call to .currencyFormatted or date formatters was allocating a new NumberFormatter/DateFormatter on the hot render path. Centralized into FormatterCache singletons, recreated only on currency/locale change — eliminates heap allocations per row render.

nodes.label: CategoryClassifier.suggestions() Dead Code Removed
nodes.rationale: suggestions(for:max:) duplicated the body of classify(_:) exactly and was never called anywhere in the codebase. Removed to eliminate dead code.
